Results Discussion The evaluation results reveal important weaknesses in cur- rentRAGdefenses.AcrossStandard,AgenticandMultimodal settings, Veritas shows that static benchmarks do not ac- curately measure robustness against adaptive attacks. While prompt-based defenses are effective against many static injec- tions, they are often bypassed by optimization-based attacks such as GCG.
